attempts.summary: Configured NFS share /srv/nfs/shared on node1 exported to node2, mounted at /mnt/shared on node2, with matching dataops (UID/GID 4500) identity on both hosts and dataops:dataops ownership, mode 2770. Verified cross-node write consistency, then performed the mandatory sequential restart of node1 then node2, confirming changed boot identity and full recovery of NFS service, mount, and data on each.
